scope: current v3 production durability producers and acknowledgement consumers before coordinator activation

hard_authority: user-visible file, delete, rename, merge, batch, and blob commit
HEAD, snapshot, fork, auth, control, and configuration publication
migration, allocator, quarantine, Void, repair, and shutdown authority
recoverable_soft_state: staged chunk/dependency presence when explicitly reported as staged

current_ledgers.name: dependency append and KV registration
observed_order: append or overwrite complete v3 entry bytes
insert in the in-memory KV write/hot buffers
current_ledgers.classification: recoverable dependency only until a later hard authority publication proves it
current_ledgers.gap: the API surface does not encode staged versus committed durability and expansion failure may be logged after the append

current_ledgers.name: v3 A/B header authority
observed_order: write the inactive v3 header slot with advanced sequence
current_ledgers.gap: no mandatory selected-slot read-back and no shared frontier/waiter owner

current_ledgers.name: transaction completion and hot-tail publication
observed_order: write updated v3 A/B header when outside a nested transaction
current_ledgers.classification: hard authority when it completes an acknowledged transaction; background durability otherwise
current_ledgers.gap: timer, explicit, transaction, and shutdown paths duplicate the ordering and failure plumbing

current_ledgers.name: KV page flush, resize, and online expansion
observed_order: rewrite mutable KV pages or relocated WAL regions
sync data and hot-tail state in multiple helper-local barriers
publish resized v3 header through an inactive slot
current_ledgers.classification: mixed hard authority and recoverable acceleration state
current_ledgers.gap: barrier ownership is inside DiskKVStore and expansion helpers; Drop can log flush failure without propagating it

current_ledgers.name: in-place deletion, Void, repair, and shutdown
observed_order: issue helper-local sync or aggregate failures during shutdown
current_ledgers.classification: hard authority except explicitly rebuildable state
current_ledgers.gap: direct writer methods and destructor work bypass one failure classifier, latch transition, and hard frontier

acknowledgement_consumers: blob check, staged chunk PUT, and blob commit
snapshot, fork, backup/import, restore, and sync
auth, permissions, system configuration, plugin, and task stores
GC, repair, integrity, migration, and shutdown tooling
p2a_1_boundary: The coordinator shell is compiled and tested but no current writer invokes it. P2a-2 must migrate barriers and hard waiters in narrow waves before architecture checks ban these bypasses.
